claim: AI will make climate change worse.
time_horizon: Ongoing and future, no end date.
occurrence: Plain-English form of the headline of Juan Cole’s article in The Nation, “AI Will Only Intensify Climate Change. The Tech Moguls Don’t Care.” (December 4, 2025).

P1.reason: A prediction. Without “only”, it no longer rules out climate benefits from AI, so there is no distinct problem with how current evidence is described.

P2.reason: Global scope matches the global data-center evidence; no distinct scope problem.

P3.reason: States a certain outcome. The IEA says the effect depends on how fast demand grows, efficiency and how the electricity is generated, and possible climate benefits from AI are neither proven nor ruled out.

W1.reason: Plain wording; no added emotional force.

W2.reason: No human-like agency is attributed to AI.

review_status: AI research draft; not independently reviewed
note: Headline claim added October 6, 2026 at Leyla’s request for spicier headlines. Scored with the same claims-us-1.0 rubric; evidence comes from the topic research brief. Changed October 7, 2026 at Leyla’s request from “AI will only intensify climate change.” (4/5) to “AI will make climate change worse.”
